entries.name: Ore
entries.desc: Crushed metal rock. Every foundry in the Orrery starts here.

entries.name: Ice Water
entries.desc: Cometary ice, cut into blocks. Drunk, grown with, and turned into glass.

entries.name: Gas Fuel
entries.desc: Hydrogen skimmed from giants. Burns in lamps, drives and furnaces.

entries.name: Rations
entries.desc: Grain, kelp and pressed protein. A colony that runs out of it stops growing and starts leaving.

entries.name: Prism Crystal
entries.desc: Lattice that holds light. Scarce, and the root of lenses and clocks.

entries.name: Brass Alloy
entries.desc: Smelted ore and fuel. Hulls, gears and warships are made of it.

entries.name: Gearwork
entries.desc: Escapements, governors and drive coils. Research and shipyards eat it.

entries.name: Lumen Glass
entries.desc: Glass that stores daylight. Every settled world wants some for its nights.
